versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the stellary-mcp skill for connecting to the hosted Stellary Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
- Supports project, board, card, document, cockpit state, and agent mission management through remote MCP.
- Requires a STELLARY_TOKEN (personal access token or agent token); no local/stdio servers or OAuth supported.
- Includes setup instructions and safe operating guidelines for connecting clients (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc.).
- Provides troubleshooting tips and clarifies supported tool list and authentication flows.
